revision_basis.reason: Preserves the original revision-1 provenance fields consumed by the phase-1 fail-closed implementation.

alignment_revision.purpose: canonical 30 m raster reconstruction from already-frozen outlet-cell coordinates; no geometry or outlet refit

pourpoint_revision_basis.structural_diagnosis: The frozen Quirio polygon was generated by polygonizing the boolean pysheds.catchment raster. The frozen outlet is the pour point used to generate that catchment, but the resulting frozen polygon can exclude the pour-point cell while adjacent in-basin D8 predecessor cells drain directly into it. Requiring the outlet center itself to be inside the polygon is therefore an implementation assumption not stated by the frozen morphometry method and is incompatible with the already-frozen delineation semantics.
pourpoint_revision_basis.correction_scope: routing topology only; preserve exact polygon mask, frozen outlet, canonical DEM, all morphometry formulas and all thresholds

frozen_geometry_input.source: exact GitHub Actions geometry artifacts referenced by the outlet-freeze registry
frozen_geometry_input.verification: SHA256 of each downloaded GeoJSON must exactly equal geometry_geojson_sha256 in the frozen registry

dem_reconstruction.source_tile_integrity: every tile must already have an identical SHA256 in preregistered outlet evidence; unknown or conflicting tiles fail closed

pourpoint_semantics.default: if frozen outlet cell is inside the exact frozen polygon mask, preserve revision-1 routing behavior unchanged

required_conditions: frozen outlet cell is not inside the exact frozen polygon center-cell mask
at least one exact in-basin D8 predecessor cell routes directly to the frozen outlet cell
frozen polygon mask is not modified or expanded
frozen outlet cell is not counted as a basin cell
routing coverage denominator remains exact frozen-polygon basin cells only
excluded_pourpoint_case.main_channel_length_rule: distance propagation starts at the frozen outlet with distance 0 and permits the final D8 link from an in-basin predecessor cell to that frozen outlet; this implements the existing frozen requirement that main channel length terminate at the frozen outlet
excluded_pourpoint_case.drainage_density_rule: unchanged from revision 1: count only qualifying links whose origin and downstream cell are both in the frozen polygon mask; do not add the exterior pour-point link

cell_inclusion.polygon_metrics: project exact frozen polygon to EPSG:32718
cell_inclusion.raster_metrics: cell center inside polygon; rasterio all_touched=false
cell_inclusion.nodata: exclude non-finite or DEM nodata cells

hydrology.routing_integrity: at least 99.5 percent of exact frozen-polygon center cells must route to the frozen outlet
hydrology.drainage_density_threshold: contributing area >= 0.01 * exact frozen polygon planar area

forbidden: read A6680 numeric morphometry before phase-1 output hash is frozen
use previously observed Cashahuacra metric values to tune any method
move an outlet or alter/expand a basin polygon
add an excluded pour-point cell to elevation, slope, area, perimeter or drainage-density masks
change source tiles, slope algorithm, D8 method, channel threshold or cell-inclusion rule based on resulting values
discard a target because of unexpected morphometry
